title: Introduction to HTML
description: Basics of HTML including what it is, structure, syntax, and doctype.

flashcards.question: What is the purpose of HTML?
flashcards.answer: To structure content on the web by using elements and tags.

flashcards.question: What tag defines the root of an HTML document?
What does the <!DOCTYPE html> declaration do?
flashcards.answer: It tells the browser that the document is an HTML5 document.

flashcards.question: Name the three main parts of an HTML document.
What kind of content goes inside the <head> tag?
flashcards.answer: Metadata like title, styles, scripts, and meta tags.

flashcards.question: What is the role of the <body> tag?
flashcards.answer: It contains all the visible content on the web page.

flashcards.question: How do you add comments in HTML?
What are HTML tags?
flashcards.answer: Keywords surrounded by angle brackets used to create elements.

flashcards.question: Is HTML case sensitive?
flashcards.answer: No, HTML tags and attributes are case-insensitive.
